construction.implementation_origin: New standalone implementation using explicitly synthetic fixtures

input.question: Required nonblank string, at most 2000 characters
input.knowledge_base: Required array, 0-100 articles with exactly unique id, title, content strings; maximum lengths 100, 500, 10000
input.unknown_fields: Rejected; duplicate JSON fields and nonfinite JSON constants rejected

output.question: Normalized question or null on error
output.answer: Exact concatenated cited content separated by two newlines, or null
output.evidence: Array of id, title, quote, score, matched_terms

shared_schema.validation: Shared validate function checks request and answer boundaries

cross_stage_handoffs: Single functionality: validated request -> content-only lexical retrieval -> ranked evidence -> validated extractive answer or abstention

behavior.retrieval: Casefolded Unicode alphanumeric token sets minus fixed English stopwords. Score is matched unique question tokens divided by unique question tokens. Positive overlap and threshold required. Sort by descending score then ascending id; take max_results.
behavior.grounding: Answers exactly reproduce cited article contents. Titles never contribute to scores. Citations must be unique retrieved ids. Optional callable receives copied evidence and must pass the same exact-extraction validation.
behavior.abstention: No qualifying evidence, empty knowledge base, or no searchable question terms returns abstained with null answer and empty citations.
behavior.cli: Exactly one JSON object to stdout. answered/abstained exit 0; validation, file, parsing and injected callable errors exit 2.
behavior.synthetic_data: All example and test articles are synthetic, not actual customer policies.

included: Optional locally injected callable with fixture validation
Runnable CLI and standard-library unit tests
excluded: Live providers, network access, embeddings and vector databases
Semantic entailment or factual verification of source articles
Enterprise authentication, persistent indexing and production operations

test_outcomes.cli_example: answered; one JSON object with synthetic-returns citation
